ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 4:1 relative to high-intensity (white) linear and circular markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity linear clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. High-contrast streaks radiate inward from the trailing edges, covering approximately 30% of the surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels. Significant deep jagged notches are present on the upper right quadrant of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed on the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete, circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) are localized near the center-bottom peduncle insertion point and scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of parallel, unaligned white linear markings (rake marks) observed across both lobes, with the highest density on the outer third of each fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring consistent with predatory rake marks and a heavily irregular, potentially traumatized trailing edge on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white 'splash' pattern at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
